entities.name: Henri-René Lenormand
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri-René Lenormand was a French playwright. He was born on 3 May 1882 in Paris. His plays, steeped in symbolism, were recognized for their explorations of subconscious motivation, deeply reflecting the influence of the theories of Sigmund Freud. He was the son of a composer, René Lenormand, and was educated at the University of Paris. He married Dutch actress Marie Kalff. Lenormand died on 16 February 1951 in Paris.

entities.summary: Henri-René Lenormand was a French playwright. He was born on 3 May 1882 in Paris. His plays, steeped in symbolism, were recognized for their explorations of subconscious motivation, deeply reflecting the influence of the theories of Sigmund Freud. He was the son of a composer, René Lenormand, and was educated at the University of Paris. He married Dutch actress Marie Kalff. Lenormand died on 16 February 1951 in Paris.
